summary: Software engineer and 2-time entrepreneur with 10 years of experience delivering backend, web and Android products across messaging, real-money gaming, payments and matchmaking. Developed distributed services with Go, Python, JS using Kafka, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis and Firestore, and operated cloud infrastructure on Kubernetes, AWS and GCP. Maintained messaging services handling billions of daily API requests, with a focus on performance, reliability, automation and integration testing. Designed infrastructure that saved $500K annually at MPL; co-founded Cloudfeather Games, helped raise $1.25M at a $5M valuation, and led 5 engineers. Contributed to open-source projects including Bitcask, Sentry and Grafana, and built AI applications using Ollama, Whisper and MLX.

experience.title: Software Engineer L4 - In-app Messaging
highlights: Maintained Go and .NET services on GKE handling billions of daily API requests; contributed to the migration from .NET to Go.
Optimised Go SSE delivery: 58 to 2,114 events/second (~36x) and 3 to 1 Firestore fetches/event in a local benchmark (96 events x 3 aliases; 5 ms simulated Firestore latency).
Reduced in-app editor memory usage by approximately 100 MB per load through Framecast and Sentry for Ember optimisations.
Worked on hosted in-app form pages and embed scripts using Temporal, GCS and a CDN, and platform support for thousands of live activities per second on Android and iOS.
Built Playwright E2E testing with SRE, scheduled through GitHub Actions with Prometheus Pushgateway metrics and Slack reporting.
Built a MySQL query UI supporting bastion/jump hosts and US/EU databases; added plugin support to local service tooling and expanded shared testing utilities.
Shared engineering work and Claude plugins for day-to-day automation through company-wide demos.

experience.title: Co-founder & CTO
highlights: Built a custom Kubernetes game-server orchestrator, proxy and autoscaler for millions of users, reducing infrastructure costs by $500K annually while improving stability at MPL.
Built 3 card-game backends processing 50K+ games/day, with matchmaking, automatic recovery and game garbage collection.
Integrated 10+ gaming platforms for authentication, payments and settlements; built supporting payment, settlement and profile modules handling 100K+ monthly transactions.
Led 5 engineers across backend, Android, web and Unity; helped raise $1.25M at a $5M valuation and led acquisition technical due diligence.
Led 4 developers delivering MPL Poker in 5 formats (NLH, PLO 4/5/6 and Rapid) for millions of monthly users; partnered with product/design and ran 3 feedback demos.
Automated Grafana dashboards and alerts with its SDK; operated Dockerised Jenkins, OpenVPN, Superset, Prometheus and Grafana.
Built a mobile score-extraction pipeline for Bountyverse using TensorFlow Lite, Keras and mean squared error; integrated creation/hunt activities with Discord.
Automated daily analytics reporting for 1,000+ users with CleverTap and Google Sheets; explored HTTP/3 image delivery and ComfyUI-based generative AI for Slark, an in-game reskinning tool.

experience.title: Software Engineer 3 - Risk & Settlement
highlights: Built a settlement pipeline enabling instant payouts for 1,000+ merchants; replaced cron jobs with a Go/Kafka delay queue that processed 100K+ settlements in 15 minutes in its 1st production run.
Integrated fraud detection with Maybank and added rule operators, improving detection by 3%; enhanced a React AML dashboard analysing 100K+ daily transactions.
Built a Docker-in-Docker integration test framework for Go, Redis, PostgreSQL, Aerospike and Kafka; contributed code-coverage and structured-logging tools.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer - Core Matchmaking
highlights: Built reverse matchmaking for thousands of providers and greedy scheduling/job-assignment algorithms handling 500+ daily requests and 50+ providers; created a React dashboard for virtual-number allocation.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer - Samsung DeX
highlights: Built a secondary taskbar for dual-screen DeX and Smart View On Display for idle-state notifications/time; reduced Android build time by 30% with a build queue for 6 engineers.

experience.title: Founding Member
highlights: Built a Python/Django coaching-management backend for 30K+ students, covering enrolments, fees, real-time updates and data synchronisation.
Developed an OMR grading tool processing 50 scans/minute; built food-ordering websites, an Android app and e-commerce websites for college entrepreneurs.

experience.title: Software Development Intern
highlights: Contributed to the backend of an internal security dashboard used by 1,600 engineers for compliance and system monitoring.
